title: Affine reconstruction from sign values
statement: Let $f$ be any real-valued function on the two signs $\{-1,1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}$. Then $f(x)=\frac{f(1)+f(-1)}{2}+\frac{f(1)-f(-1)}{2}x$.
